subject: general
question:
A statement is given followed by two possible underlying assumptions I and II. Read all the information carefully and decide which of the given assumptions can be assumed by the given

**Statement:**

Following Country G’s decision, which was taken a decade ago to control pollution, Country N has also decided to keep a cap on the number of cars in the country. So, now if someone in Country N wants to buy a car, they will have to wait until someone in the country sells their car or a car is registered as completely non-functional and is scrapped.

**Assumptions:**

I. The other transport options in Country N are enough to cater to the ‘non-car owning’ population of the country.

II. The decision was most likely successful in Country G in controlling pollution.

options.text: Neither I nor II can be assumed
Both I and II can be assumed
